entry.title: E.l.f. Beauty growth driven by innovation, not just pricing power
entry.summary: The company’s Q2 net sales jumped 51%, with industry analysts in awe of its go-to-market capabilities and Rhode brand strength.

entry.title: Ikea leans into events for the holidays
entry.summary: Two locations will feature outdoor markets, while all stores will host holiday events this month. The furniture retailer also expanded its assortment.

entry.title: Amazon adds over 100 Alexa for Shopping functions
entry.summary: New capabilities include managing subscriptions, resolving billing questions, and creating and editing lists and registries.

entry.title: Walmart ramps up Sparky features in time for the holidays
entry.summary: New visual recognition and cart generation capabilities for the AI assistant aim to ease the pain of holiday shopping, both online and in stores.

entry.title: The Weekly Closeout: What’s next for CVS retail and Canada Goose net loss widens
entry.summary: The separation of CVS Health could present an opportunity for its retail pharmacies. Meanwhile, higher costs are impacting the luxury apparel brand.

entry.title: As Barbie stumbles, Mattel cuts forecast ahead of the holidays
entry.summary: When asked if he had a catchphrase or mission statement, CEO Roger Lynch on his first earnings call said, “Oh give me a break, I just got here.”

entry.title: Reformation implements new AI planning tool, helping in-stock rates
entry.summary: The apparel brand's Q3 net revenue jumped 19% and analysts remarked on its strong performance as a newly public company.

entry.title: Under Armour to sell more full-price product at outlet stores
entry.summary: The move is part of a broader store revamp and comes as the athletics brand tries to increase its premium positioning in the market.

entry.title: The Children’s Place shakes up leadership amid bankruptcy rumors
entry.summary: With various executives and directors out, including the CEO, the children’s apparel retailer’s CFO has taken over as principal executive officer.

entry.title: Bed Bath & Beyond’s new concept takes a page from original format
entry.summary: The store, with familiar elements like the towel wall and coupons, comes as its parent company reported strong revenue gains driven by recent acquisitions.
